extraction.Name: Lily Rice DuBray
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded July 27, 1922, by the Farmers State Bank, Witten
extraction.Buyer: Deed dated July 7, 1924, by Lily and Peter DuBray conveyed the land to Anna M. Harbaugh for $1.00 and other valuable consideration; mortgaged by Lily Rice DuBray and Peter DuBray for $700 in favor of Fred W. Rahn, mortgage dated July 24, 1926
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739634 issued; The South half of Section 11, township 102, north of range 77; receipt for the patent was signed April 8, 1920, by the allottee
